committed_findings.summary: The draft is understandable to an expert reader without conversation history. Its abstract identifies the precise 53-point result, the opening defines the family conventions, and the numbered results lead from counting inequalities to support bounds and then finite reduction. I found no material expository ambiguity requiring revision. The manuscript digest matches.

checks.method: Read the complete frozen manuscript, tracing definitions, theorem references, inherited inputs, proof transitions, assurance qualifications, and the final remaining obligation.
checks.observation: The reader can distinguish support size from family cardinality, a checked reduction from exclusion, and local formal coverage from the external enumeration claim. The four-star proof explicitly reuses the preceding notation; the final certificate paragraph states the missing encoding, coverage, symmetry, and refutation obligations. The coverage table connects mathematical results to source modules, while the methods paragraph limits reproducibility claims.
checks.scope: Standalone integrated argument and contribution narrative

committed_findings.summary: The strongest abstract and conclusion claims remain within the checked interfaces. External vacuity is acknowledged without being used to establish the local support result. Both frozen hashes match; no integrated scope revision is required.

checks.method: Compared the abstract, prior-work qualification, and conclusion with LiteralStatements, SupportFinish53, and SupportReduction.
checks.observation: The assembled theorem concludes actual union cardinality <=53 for Type u under the advertised family hypotheses, without assuming I(27). The equivalence uses the named Type-level I(27), while separate counterexample reductions cover arbitrary universes. Neither direction establishes finite nonexistence. Importing the external I(27) result would make the 28-member class empty, as the manuscript states; this limits extremal significance but does not invalidate an independently assembled conditional support theorem. No existence, sharpness, exclusion, or new extremal-value claim is made.
checks.scope: Actual support, universe quantification, and exclusion boundaries

committed_findings.summary: The remaining exclusion obligation is concrete and accurately delimited. The Boolean-incidence lemma supplies a local semantic component, while the report explicitly leaves complete encoding, coverage, symmetry justification, and checked refutation unfinished. Frozen hashes and the inspected source hash match.

checks.method: Read equal_intersections_iff_no_exact_two in SupportBound.lean, tested all eight point-membership patterns, and compared the future-work paragraph with Theorem 5.
checks.observation: The lemma equates equal pairwise intersections with absence of membership patterns 110, 101, 011. It assumes neither distinct rows nor cardinality four and proves no family-level exclusion. A full incidence target needs 28 distinct four-element rows on 53 columns, pairwise intersection, and an exactly-two witness for every row triple, with a proven encoding bridge. The report identifies the finite obstruction and explicitly reserves these completeness and certificate obligations; successful reduction compilation is not presented as UNSAT evidence.
checks.scope: Finite exclusion interface versus local Boolean semantics

committed_findings.summary: The integrated manuscript maintains a consistent scope from abstract through final limitations. Frozen hashes match. I found no cross-section promotion of a reduction, numerical leaf, or compilation result into an exclusion theorem.

checks.method: Read the complete frozen manuscript and traced assumptions and conclusions across Theorems 1–5, the verification table, and the closing limitations.
checks.observation: Theorems 1–2 provide general counting statements; sunflower hypotheses enter the degree and codegree caps used for 72,56,53. checks.method: Read the entire frozen manuscript, tracking the abstract, support theorems, grid paragraph, finite equivalence, failed-search paragraph, and representation comparison.
checks.observation: The 53 bound counts supported points of a 28-member family; 112 counts incidences. The 1,484 incidence bits equal 28 times 53, whereas 292,825 counts candidate four-subsets for a different representation. The 8,855/6,031 counts concern degree quadruples, not families. The budget-59 diagnostic explicitly constructs no family and establishes no optimality. The 150-second search budget is reported separately from representation counts, with no solver outcome. checks.method: Cross-read both universal moment signatures, inherited cap proofs, and every use of hf in SupportFinish53.

Sunflower-freeness enters the assembled proof through degree<=19, pair-codegree<=6 and triple-codegree<=2. checks.method: Compared the reused n,P,W definitions with SupportFinish53, SupportReduction, and the actual support definition.
checks.observation: Theorem 4 reuses definitions for the same 28-member family, then introduces its own contradiction assumption n≥54 and budget 58; it does not retain Theorem 3’s n≥57 assumption. SupportFinish53 directly combines the degree envelope, four-star correction, and grid, without calling the support-56 theorem or assuming I(27). Lean uses Q=Σd², so Q−112=2P matches the prose. Support is literally family.biUnion id throughout. Only after this bound is proved does Theorem 5 extract 28 members and injectively relabel their support. No circularity or quotient substitution appears.
